dataHubModel.description:
Grid asset and measurement context data product of a transmission system operator: substations, grid equipment, transmission lines (topology from the network model), the catalogue of measurement points (SCADA, PMU, power-quality and sensor signals) and their 15-minute aggregates. Consumers: control-centre applications, operational planning, analytics and asset management.

AI agent instructions: Reason on golden records. Measurements are aggregates; raw streams stay in the operational historian under the measurement point tag. Units come from the measurement point.
dataHubModel.label: Grid Asset Data Product

documentationConfig.documentation: Application of the grid asset and measurement context data product: maintain, govern and consume substations, assets, lines and measurement points.

entities.description:
Catalogue entry of one measured signal (SCADA point, PMU channel, power-quality meter or sensor): what is measured, where, by which device, in which unit and at which rate. It links an operational data stream to its network context.

AI agent instructions: The raw stream stays in the historian under the same PointTag; this record describes it. The unit of every value of the point is the Unit attribute.
